name: Cervical Spondylotic Amyotrophy
definition: Motor-predominant cervical degenerative syndrome causing weakness and muscle wasting of one or more upper-limb myotomes with relatively limited sensory symptoms.

investigations.principle: MRI cervical spine plus electrodiagnostic testing helps distinguish root/anterior horn pathology and mimics.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Progressive motor deficit or significant compression may require surgical decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuromuscular phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Motor-predominant cervical degenerative syndrome causing weakness and muscle wasting of one or more upper-limb myotomes with relatively limited sensory symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Cervical Neck Pain or Cervical Radiculopathy
